name: Today (live)
desc: Today's "Smart or lucky?" section on the live page, as it draws now.

name: D1 · The plot (pick)
desc: The ops room, wide: the P&L plotted in grease pencil on the big glass in its perspective; the window light crosses the marks; the two officers in front cover the foot of the board. Lead line, window tabs, axis, names written on the glass; desktop rows on the glass between the officers' heads.

name: D2 · Edge-lit glass
desc: Close up on the edge-lit perspex: every mark glows from the edge light, rows ruled on the glass under the chart. The plotter's hand is behind the sheet, dimmed by it, its pencil on the leader's newest point; it walks to the new leader on a switch.

name: E · In the green (etched)
desc: The chip's board: each P&L a copper trace routed like a real board (straight runs, 45-degree bends), lit from the painting's upper left; a pad and via at each end; break-even the gold ground bus; names, axis, switch and rows in silkscreen.

name: F · On the big board (mine)
desc: A 1920s exchange: the chart chalked on the slate wall that boards like this carried prices on, in its perspective, the clerk on the ladder and the crowd in front; rows chalked on a strip of the same slate under the rail.
